Messages.Author: Simon Klibisch
Messages.Body:

Will Disarm, played in combat against a vampire which has already played
Undead Persistance, send that vampire to torpor?
Thanks in advance,
Simon

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Simon Klibisch wrote:
>
> Hi!
> Will Disarm, played in combat against a vampire which has already played
> Undead Persistance, send that vampire to torpor?

No. UP prevents the vampire from going to torpor for the duration of combat.
